acceptOwnership().details: The new owner accepts the ownership transfer.

executeWaterfall(uint256,uint256,uint256.details: The vault MUST have approved this contract for `grossProfit` before calling.         Approval is typically done with `forceApprove` directly before this call.         Steps:           1. Pull grossProfit from vault into escrow           2. Deduct purification (purificationBps) — send to charityWallet directly           3. Approve CharityModule for remaining; call distributeCharity()           4. Call shariahTreasury.calculateMusharakahSplit() on remainder after charity           5. Push vaultShare to shariahTreasury via recordMusharakahProfit           6. Push depositorShare back to vault           7. Emit WaterfallExecuted

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

pendingOwner().details: Returns the address of the pending owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

setPurificationBps(uint256).details: ONLY raise this when the board has identified a specific impure-income event.         Cannot exceed MAX_PURIFICATION_BPS (10%). Combined with charityBps must not         exceed MAX_COMBINED_DEDUCTION_BPS (50%).

transferOwnership(address).details: Starts the ownership transfer of the contract to a new account. Replaces the pending transfer if there is one. Can only be called by the current owner. Setting `newOwner` to the zero address is allowed; this can be used to cancel an initiated ownership transfer.

MAX_COMBINED_DEDUCTION_BPS().notice: Hard cap: purification + charity combined cannot exceed 50%.

MAX_PURIFICATION_BPS().notice: Hard cap: purificationBps cannot exceed 10% of gross profit.

executeWaterfall(uint256,uint256,uint256.notice: Execute the full Shariah profit waterfall.

purificationBps().notice: Fraction of grossProfit to set aside as purification (default 0).         Raised only when the board identifies a specific impure-income event.
